headline: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed that the Company has received the Observation Letters with  no objection  from the NSE and  no adverse observations  from the BSE on September 22, 2026.
